name: Alpine Clock
description: A station-style clock screensaver: the second hand sweeps the dial in 58.5 seconds and waits at twelve, then the minute hand steps on. With an optional Alpine ridge across the face.
author: missing-foss

settings.title: Face
settings.description: A dark face or a light one. The page around it is black either way.

settings.title: Mountains
settings.description: An Alpine ridge across the lower half of the face.

settings.title: Numbers
settings.description: Hour numbers in place of the hour marks. The minute dots stay.

settings.title: Custom hand colours
settings.description: Off, the hands follow the face.

settings.title: Size
settings.description: How much of the screen's shorter side the clock fills.

settings.title: Slow drift
settings.description: Moves the clock a little each minute, round a small circle once an hour.
